evidence: policy/docs-rubric.md RULE.DOC.SIGNATURE_MIRROR: "How much of the method the signature repeats is this package's to set, and it is {{rubric.signature_types}}." Sync.jl SIGNATURE_TEXT["names"]: "the names and their defaults, and no types: a type belongs to the argument's own bullet". ARCHITECTURE §5: "this package takes `names`". ext: "gate_or_skip(cfg, what) -> Bool" — untyped, and SCAN.SIGNATURE_TYPED would hit the typed form the finding asked for.

detail.why_sound: The finding asked that gate_or_skip's docstring signature repeat `what::AbstractString` from `function gate_or_skip(cfg, what::AbstractString)`. Under the current tree that is not merely unnecessary, it is a positive violation: RULE.DOC.SIGNATURE_MIRROR now carries the variation point rubric.signature_types (schema/config.schema.json enum names|mirror, default names), this package takes names (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md line 102; CHANGELOG 'this package, SS, IT and CP take the default'), and under names SCAN.SIGNATURE_TYPED (catalog/scans.toml, triage, surfaces src+ext, registered by src/Scans/signature_typed.jl, loaded by Scan.jl's readdir loop over src/Scans/) hits any docstring signature whose parenthesised argument list carries a `::`.
detail.no_residue: The claim's substance does not survive relocation to the bullet: RULE.DOC.ARGS_FORM binds the bulleted form only at three or more arguments or any keyword, and gate_or_skip takes two, so 'The arguments are `cfg`, the validated config, and `what`, the sentence the skip line ends with.' is the prescribed prose form; RULE.DOC.ARGCOV accepts a plain code span, and both names appear as one.
detail.corpus_check: grep -rnE '^ {4}[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_!]*\([^)]*::' over src/ and ext/ returns zero typed docstring signature lines, so the whole corpus is in the names form; the only `::` left in a signature line is Demote.jl's typed RETURN after `->`, which signature_typed.jl deliberately leaves outside the list it judges. Under mirror the 451 arguments CHANGELOG records as untyped would all be hits, which is independent confirmation of the configured value.
detail.tests: test/scans.jl asserts both directions for the scan: under names `any(h -> occursin("typed_signature", h.text), r.hits)` and `!any(h -> occursin("returns_typed", ...))`; under a config forced to mirror, `mirrored_bare` becomes the hit and `typed_signature` stops being one.
detail.tripwire: The dismissal's own reasoning field states the reopening condition correctly: RULE.DOC.SIGNATURE_MIRROR being widened again to require the method's types in the signature line (equivalently, this package's config moving to mirror) makes the finding live again.
